title: Taj Mahal
shortDescription: Ivory-white marble mausoleum on the Yamuna riverfront — the world's greatest monument of love.
description: Commissioned in 1631 by Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan for Empress Mumtaz Mahal. UNESCO World Heritage Site renowned for its symmetrical marble architecture, pietra dura inlay, and reflecting pools. Best experienced at dawn from the East Gate.
